Final categorization: OK  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that explicitly simulates future urban land expansion—a specific LULC class—at the national scale of China (entire country). The primary objective is to model and evaluate future urban expansion using an improved LUSD-urban model, which constitutes LULC prediction as the central research question. It implements five localized Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs) as distinct future scenarios and quantitatively compares their outcomes (e.g., urban land growth ranges: 3.94–9.03 × 10⁴ km²). The modeling is spatially explicit at 1 km resolution, includes mapped projections for 2020–2050, and reports quantitative accuracy metrics (OA = 99.45%, Kappa = 0.73, FoM = 0.26; 15–32% improvement over other models). All core inclusion criteria are met, and no exclusion criteria apply.)
